feeds.title: AIM at Melanoma Blog
feeds.description: AIM at Melanoma is globally engaged and locally invested in advancing the battle against melanoma through innovative research, legislative reform, education, and patient and caregiver support.

feeds.title: Melanoma UK News
feeds.description: Covers patient stories health and fitness tips fundraising ideas and charity news. Melanoma UK is a patient support group set up to raise awareness of the causes of Melanoma skin cancer and help sufferers.

feeds.title: Stronghold Ministry Blog
feeds.description: A ministry to cancer patients by Stage IV melanoma survivor. Our passion to support cancer patients is borne out of the battle that Joe had with Stage IV metastatic melanoma.

feeds.title: lucysmelanomaadventure
feeds.description: This blog is about my melanoma story. In May 2011, aged 34, I was diagnosed with Malignant Melanoma with a scar on my back and one in my armpit.

feeds.title: I'll Live
feeds.description: My name is Deborah Wassertzug, I am 45 years old, and I have metastatic melanoma.

feeds.title: David Cornfield Melanoma Fund Blog
feeds.description: The David Cornfield Melanoma Fund was established in 2007 to take action on melanoma. The DCMF is devoted to saving lives from melanoma through awareness, prevention and research.

feeds.title: Schwaming Cancer
feeds.description: My name is Elana Schwam and I'm 29 years old. I have recently been diagnosed with Stage 3B Malignant Melanoma at the end of June 2016. This blog is about my personal adventures and lessons learned while beating the shit out of Stage 3 Melanoma.

feeds.title: The Melanoma Fund UK Blog
feeds.description: Our Mission is putting an end to melanoma by raising awareness of melanoma, educate everyone about the disease and fund research to help find a cure.

feeds.title: Chaotically Precise: Life, Love, and Melanoma
feeds.description: The story of living in spite of melanoma, metastasis, vaccines, anti PD1, lung removal, and sterotactic radiation. The story of life with family and friends.

feeds.title: Melanoma Journey
feeds.description: A blog by Mick Cullip covering his melanoma journey. Follow us for his latest updates.

feeds.title: Pink Melanoma
feeds.description: My skin cancer journey. Its just about two years ago that my pink spot made an appearance on my right knee. I was diagnosed with a melanotic nodular melanoma skin cancer.

feeds.title: Melanoma Awarness
feeds.description: Melanona experiences and awareness and hope for those diagnosed with this very deadly cancer of the skin. The author of this blog is 46 years old and a cancer survivor.

feeds.title: Alli's equilibrium
feeds.description: This blog alli's equilibrium, is about author's journey who is fighting melanoma disease.

feeds.title: Melanoma and Mimosas
feeds.description: A close-up look at stage IV melanoma, and what makes life worth living in the face of death.

feeds.title: From sweet and salty to stage IV metastatic melanoma and everything in between
feeds.description: I'm a 34 year old Utah girl who is fighting stage IV melanoma for a second time. Former caramel queen and coffee slinger. Finding out whats next, one day at a time.

feeds.title: Adventures With My Enemy Melanoma Blog
feeds.description: I'm Chelsea and I am a beach lovin', tanning bed hating, want-to-be Carrie Bradshaw who was diagnosed with Stage III Melanoma at age 23. Learn from my mistakes, folks. Now it is my goal to save another young soul from the craziness that now makes up the majority of my life. Remember, it's not just skin cancer.

feeds.title: The Naked Gardiner Blog
feeds.description: I am Kathy Gardiner (or better known as The Naked Gardiner) and here I take you on my journey through my life of mindfulness, clean eating and living, pursuing my foodie love by creating plant-based whole food recipes; exploring sustainable products; navigating a path of self-love and inner healing… all while having a biff with terminally diagnosed Advanced Metastatic Melanoma.

feeds.title: Melanoma Rollercoaster
feeds.description: My blog Melanoma Rollercoaster tells you about the Rollercoaster ride I am on with Melanoma. I write a blog to raise awareness. I hope that this blog helps to keep my loved ones up to date with what is happening for me & that it also helps to raise awareness about Melanoma & Skin Cancer in general.

feeds.title: Isolated Limb Perfusion: My Experience
feeds.description: Working to beat the melanoma beast. My fight against melanoma began with multiple surgeries and intensive interferon. I received my diagnosis of malignant melanoma on December 17, 2007. My hope is that by sharing my personal experience the mystery will be removed for others, whether they will be undergoing an intensive interferon treatment.

feeds.title: A Melanoma Journey
feeds.description: I am sharing my experience with skin cancer. I was diagnosed with Stage 3 melanoma in February 2014.

feeds.title: Melanoma In Me
feeds.description: An Irish woman trying to find her way through the turmoil of a stage 4 diagnosis of Malignant Melanoma. She has been a melanoma patient since 2004.

feeds.title: Wrestling Melanoma
feeds.description: My name is Mark Sims I was diagnosed with Stage 4 malignant melanoma on the 18th of February last year at the age of 27. This is dedicated to those people who participated into the drug trials many whom would have died so that I could have lived. It is due to them that there are treatments available to patients like me.

feeds.title: Melanoma Mama
feeds.description: This blog is about melanoma awareness & tanning bed dangers, my daughter Jaime Regen Rea's story. In loving memory of my daughter Jaime and her courageous 9-year battle with melanoma, I am a melanoma awareness advocate and the indoor tanning industry's worst nightmare.

feeds.title: Melanoma Mama
feeds.description: This blog is for Brittany Dixon who is now fighting stage 4 Melanoma disease.

feeds.title: I'm still the princess
feeds.description: A blog that covers a variety of subjects, including spiritual life, parenting, food allergies, miscarriage, writing and literature.

feeds.title: Meredith Legg Stapleton
feeds.description: This blog was created to share memories, pictures and stories about our beautiful Meredith. On April 13, 2009, at age 22, Meredith was diagnosed with ocular melanoma, a rare form of cancer that affects around 2,000 Americans per year.

feeds.title: Facing Melanoma
feeds.description: A blog about my fight with metastatic malignant melanoma skin cancer. I was diagnosed with malignant melanoma in January 2014.

feeds.title: Attitude of Gratitude
feeds.description: When I first started this blog I was melanoma stage 3b, now I'm stage 4. Though I blog about melanoma often, this is not a melanoma specific blog.

feeds.title: Team Vaughn vs. Melanoma
feeds.description: Team Vaughn vs. Melanoma is blog about the author's journey with Melanoma disease.

feeds.title: My Melanoma Story
feeds.description: I am 31 years old. I am a wife, daughter, sister and friend living with Stage 4 metastatic melanoma. This is an insight into my story. I have mostly good days but occasionally the reality of my condition will hit and try to tear me down. View all posts by My Melanoma Story.

feeds.title: Melanoma Action and Support Scotland
feeds.description: This blog is Scotland's only dedicated skin cancer charity. MASScot aims to support people who have been diagnosed with Melanoma and other skin cancers. We provide complementary support, counselling and therapy services for skin cancer patients and their carers.

feeds.title: Prayers for Meredith
feeds.description: This blog is for updates & encouragement regarding progress, treatments, fundraising efforts & more for Meredith Horn who is fighting metastatic melanoma.

feeds.title: Just Part of My Story - Melanoma
feeds.description: I'm just your typical 28 year old girl living a fabulous life in Tampa, Florida. My diagnosis with Stage III Melanoma has certain thrown my family and me a major curve ball in life. My goal is to share my story as I battle this cancer and spread awareness and prevention tips along the way.

feeds.title: Melanoma News Today
feeds.description: Melanoma News Today is a digital news publication dedicated to offering comprehensive daily news coverage of melanoma.

feeds.title: The Peters Family
feeds.description: This blog is about the fighting against Melanoma disease.

feeds.title: The Hotel Melanoma
feeds.description: My blog reflects an ongoing quest to find the good stuff and the funny stuff I've stumbled into during my stay at The Hotel Melanoma since receiving a Stage IIIc diagnosis in 2003. And to raise awareness about this relatively unknown brand of cancer. Please make a donation to your favorite melanoma nonprofit organization to fund melanoma education, prevention and treatment research.

feeds.title: Melanoma Action Coalition Blog
feeds.description: The Melanoma Action Coalition is an organization of community based foundations and individuals focused on increasing awareness about melanoma, providing education about sun safety, and raising money for melanoma research.

feeds.title: Melanoma Canada Blog
feeds.description: Our organization is a national, patient-led organization whose mission is to provide melanoma patients and their caregivers with current and accurate information and services in the fight against melanoma. Through the MNC network we provide funding for awareness, education, advocacy and research.

feeds.title: MedWorm - Melanoma News
feeds.description: MedWorm.com provides a medical RSS filtering service. Thousands of medical RSS feeds are combined and output via different filters. This feed contains the latest news in Melanoma

feeds.title: the Impatient Patient
feeds.description: A blog about melanoma skin cancer - and thyroid cancer! - and how to live the journey.
